question: Among all patients, how many individuals remain alive (i.e., with no recorded deceased.dateTime), have a diagnosis of either Diabetes or Hypertension, and are prescribed at least seven distinct active medications?
sql:
-- Verify: check how many alive patients have diabetes/hypertension AND 7+ meds
WITH diagnosis_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT subject.patientId as patient_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c
  WHERE c.code.coding[SAFE_ORDINAL(1)].code IN ('44054006', '38341003')
    AND subject.patientId IS NOT NULL
),
medication_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    subject.patientId as patient_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.medication_request`
  WHERE status = 'active'
    AND subject.patientId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY subject.patientId
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT medication.codeableConcept.coding[SAFE_ORDINAL(1)].code) >= 7
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as patient_count
FROM diagnosis_patients dp
JOIN medication_counts mc ON dp.patient_id = mc.patient_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.patient` p ON dp.patient_id = p.id
WHERE p.deceased.dateTime IS NULL
